//: Two-layer contract at the type level (D-MED-005, INV-TRUTH-001). This is a *composite* project whose file list is the learner-observable evidence layer plus the layer-neutral common/vocab/version modules only. TypeScript refuses (TS6307) any import that reaches a file outside this list, so an evidence module that imported anything from src/reference/ would fail `pnpm typecheck`. It also compiles with no Node types: the evidence layer is platform-free. scripts/check-layer-separation.mjs proves the mechanism bites by compiling layer-fixtures/ against tsconfig.layer-fixture.json and expecting exactly that error.
